Herdline 0.6.92 (Experimental, 10145)

- Stacked editable Chat combines Working, Stop and reply metadata into one compact block above the input, removing the separate Working row and its duplicate vertical touch-target budget.
- Short conversations are bottom-aligned: unused list space is above the conversation, not between its final message and the input. Long history keeps normal message order and scrolling.
- Removed redundant normal list-bottom and composer-top padding at this boundary. Details and Stop retain separate 48dp targets. Pending and Stop failure explanations remain visible below the merged block; Latest-pill clearance is preserved when needed.
- Existing Stop routes and transcript reads are unchanged. Dense/read-only Chat keeps its existing in-list fallback.

Verification: focused StopOutcome, ChatFooter and ComposerFit checks, QA/test/signed builds, and unchanged ChatScrollToEndTest (3 tests) passed. Actual Chat on an isolated Android 17 emulator used recorded sample transcripts and a real patched OMP companion without ingress notices, with synthetic Working status and no LLM calls. Short/fitting and long/scrolling histories with keyboard hidden/shown measured 52.2dp from final content text to editor, versus 171dp for the previous unpublished 10144 short fixture. Stop pending/unconfirmed words remained visible; no real-model stop success is claimed. Dense/read-only, final signed runtime and Samsung were not separately exercised.
